bullets.title: Rivers and Tides (documentary)
bullets.note: ](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/qgi8h7hp326on/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9SaXZlcnMtVGlkZXMtQW5keS1Hb2xkc3dvcnRoeS9kcC9CMDdHWVZSNUhMLw==)**.** I first learned of Andy Goldsworthy through Johns Hopkins’ medical staff, who introduced me to [one of his amazing books](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/97fzhnhr832zn/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9BbmR5LUdvbGRzd29ydGh5LUNvbGxhYm9yYXRpb24tTmF0dXJlL2RwLzA4MTA5MzM1MTkv) in their session room used for psilocybin studies. This classic documentary complements the book and shows his art (and the artist) in process. It won’t resonate with everyone, and it’s a bit odd, but it will strike a chord with many. This is especially true if you’ve spent some time in non-ordinary states. Before watching, I suggest seeing one of his books or at least looking at [images of some of his artwork in nature](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/nmtohvh045o62/aHR0cDovL3d3dy5hcnRuZXQuY29tL2FydGlzdHMvYW5keS1nb2xkc3dvcnRoeS8=).

bullets.title: Lisbon
bullets.note: I’d love to make my way to Portugal in 2019 and check out Lisbon, which I recently learned from [Wikipedia](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/r4s8hohzpv5w4/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvTGlzYm9u) is one of the oldest cities in the world. It is certainly one of the oldest in Western Europe, predating other modern European capitals such as London, Paris, and Rome by centuries. Specifically, I’d love to see the [São Jorge Castle](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/vma3hrhr63ker/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvUyVDMyVBM29fSm9yZ2VfQ2FzdGxl) and [Praça do Comércio](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/mmb7h5hzx0nmp/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvUHJhJUMzJUE3YV9kb19Db20lQzMlQTlyY2lv). Do you have any other must-see or must-do recommendations for Portugal? Please let me know by sending [a tweet to @tferriss](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/edhph7hozwnq3/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcw==) with #timinportugal!

bullets.title: The Duolingo Spanish Podcast
bullets.note: At the time of this writing, the Duolingo Spanish Podcast is one of the top 50 most popular shows on iTunes/Apple Podcasts, out of 500,000+ podcasts. I’ve been using it to prepare for an upcoming trip to South America, and I started with a fun episode called “Flamenco,” which took me back to Buenos Aires, Argentina, where I used to live ([here are some travel tips](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/p3ieh9hoe57gq/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDA3LzAzLzMwL2hvdy10by1saXZlLWxpa2UtYS1yb2NrLXN0YXItb3ItdGFuZ28tc3Rhci1pbi1idWVub3MtYWlyZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTViZg==)). I [listened to the audio while reading the transcript here](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/65feh8he462n3/aHR0cHM6Ly9wb2RjYXN0LmR1b2xpbmdvLmNvbS9lcGlzb2RlLTE5LWZsYW1lbmNv). The episodes are short (often <20 min), effective, and unique. Here’s the official description: “True stories for English speakers learning Spanish. From the makers of Duolingo, the most popular language-learning app, comes a new podcast that delivers fascinating real-life stories in easy-to-understand Spanish with English narration. These are not language lessons; they’re life lessons through language. Hosted by Martina Castro, co-founder of NPR’s Radio Ambulante.” Full disclosure: I invested in Duolingo ([the app, software, etc.](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/50tvh7h2wo9kw/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHVvbGluZ28uY29tLw==)) many years ago because their free language learning platform was the best I’d ever seen. They now offer 35+ languages and have approximately 300 million registered users. I continue to be super impressed by the entire team, the products they develop, and the initiatives they pursue (e.g., [preserving Diné/Navajo](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/gku0l36gga5hkq9od/qrc8h7hp326ox/aHR0cHM6Ly9ueXBvc3QuY29tLzIwMTgvMTEvMjQvaG93LW9uZS1tYW4taXMtdGVhY2hpbmctYW1lcmljYS10by1zcGVhay1uYXZham8v) and other endangered languages).
